title: Top up
subtitle: Choose a plan that matches your interview prep pace.
sub_active_note: Your monthly pass is active. New sessions won't deduct from your quota.
stripe_note: Secured by Stripe — you will be redirected to checkout.stripe.com
faq_a1: Credits from a one-time package are valid for 90 days. Monthly pass credits never expire as long as your subscription is active.
faq_q2: What happens if I run out of credits mid-interview?
faq_a2: If a session is already in progress, it finishes normally. Only new sessions are paused until you top up or your monthly pass renews.
faq_a3: Unused credits can be refunded in full within 7 days of purchase. Contact support with your payment ID.
faq_q4: Does the monthly pass auto-renew? How do I cancel?
faq_a4: No — it's manual renewal by default. We send an in-app reminder 3 days before expiry, and your pass quietly stops. You're never auto-charged.
faq_q5: Do you support invoices for company reimbursement?
faq_a5: Yes. After payment, open the order and click "Request invoice". Enter your company name and tax ID — the e-invoice arrives in your email within 3 business days.
faq_q6: Is payment secure? Do you see my card number?
faq_a6: We never see your card. Payment is handled end-to-end on Stripe's checkout, and we only receive a success or failure callback.
faq_q7: After my monthly pass expires, do I lose my resumes and interview history?
faq_a7: No. Your resumes and past reports stay in your account permanently. When the pass expires you only stop accumulating new interview credits; everything you've already generated remains viewable.
faq_q8: Do you have a team or enterprise plan?
faq_a8: Yes. For teams of 3 or more, email hi@rally.example. We offer consolidated invoicing, a shared credit pool, and an admin dashboard. We get back to you within 5 business days.
